item.title: M90 Queensferry (Northbound)
item.description:
🟠 Traffic restrictions
• The M90 is closed northbound between Junction 1a Queensferry and Junction 1b Ferry Toll due to overnight roadworks. The closure includes the Queensferry Crossing and drivers should divert via the Forth Road Bridge.
Updated: 22:11
